question: With what substances must that body be continually filled in this practice?
premises: That body is the object to be filled.
Milk and other fillings serve as the filling substances.
The act of filling is to be performed continually.
inference: One should continually fill that body with milk-derived and other filling substances.
uncertainties: The exact morphological analysis of kṣīrādā is uncertain.
The ellipsis .... indicates omitted material whose content is unknown.
plain_english: One should always fill that body with milk and other fillings.
